en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a forest path along a river. On the left, tall coniferous trees line a dirt road where a few people walk with umbrellas or hats. On the right, the river bends away, with rocks and a low wooden structure or dam visible in the water and forested banks in the distance. Along the entire lower margin there is a handwritten message in cursive script. In the bottom-right corner, faint printed text appears.
